overview: The Medford School Committee approved an MCAS late-entry testing pilot for Medford High School, reviewed enrollment and revenue projections for the FY27 budget, and passed resolutions concerning extreme cold weather protocols and strategic planning.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations with SEIU Local 88 cafeteria workers, later returning to announce the ratification of their contract.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, budget transfers, donations, and the meeting minutes from March 2, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Winter Sports Recognition
items.summary: The committee recognized local winter sports athletes, GBL champions, and All-Stars alongside Athletic Director Rob O'Leary and varsity team coaches.

items.title: MHS MCAS Flex Pilot
items.summary: Approved a pilot program implementing a late-entry schedule for non-testing juniors and seniors and specialized seminars for freshmen during May math MCAS exams.

items.title: FY27 Enrollment and Revenue Estimates Report
items.summary: Received a detailed presentation analyzing declining enrollment projections, Chapter 70 state aid allocations, revolving fund balances, and upcoming budget cost drivers.

items.title: Resolution: Extreme Cold Temperature Mitigation Plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the district to establish a cold weather safety plan, including relocation protocols for classrooms with vulnerable heating and electrical systems.

items.title: Resolution: Strategic Planning Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved a resolution tasking the strategic planning subcommittee to meet and define the process, deliverables, and timeline for the development of a community-informed strategic plan.
